get.description:
Returns a list of valid filter options when given a specific filter type.

Note: When using "biller" for column_id, the "value" key will contain objects, not integers.

These objects will have a "type" field and a "value" field. Type indicates whether the biller
is a Sub Job or a Project and will be a string. "value" contains the ID of the biller and will be an array of integers.

parameters.name: column_id
parameters.description: Type of filter options to return

schema.description: Array of Budget Detail Filter Options

label.description: Localized display label for the filter option (for example a cost code's long name, a vendor name, or "None"). Options that share the same label are grouped into a single entry.

value.description: Record IDs represented by this option. Pass these values in the "filters" object of the List Budget Details request to filter rows by this option. A single option can contain multiple IDs when records share the same label. Note: when column_id is "biller", each item is an object with "type" and "value" keys instead of an integer (see the endpoint description).

items.description: ID of a record to filter budget detail rows by
